👋 Feedback Requested!

We currently provide Full Self-Driving tracking (per drive) as part of our Pro subscription ($6.99/month).

We want to extend this to Plus subscribers ($3.99/month), making it the cheapest FSD tracking offered anywhere.

Is that a better deal? Let us know.
(By the way, there's no additional cost. The $6.99 and $3.99 a month is for the entire subscription, which would include unlimited Full Self-Driving tracking!)

For our Pro subscribers, we'll be augmenting your FSD tracking with disengagements, better FSD usage breakdowns, and more in May.

We also just unlocked service alert history for Pro subscribers this week, with refinements coming next week.
